title: Axon Hub | Auto Fling, Silent Aim, Anti Grab, Grab All & ESP
features:
Axon Hub is a complete Fling Things and People script featuring advanced flinging, grabbing, targeting, protection, object control, trolling, movement, and ESP tools.

🌪️ FLING

• Adjustable Fling Strength

• Multiple Fling Directions

• Fling Selected Player

• Teleport and Fling

• Automatic Fling

• Fling All Players

• Server Fling All

• Fling Touch with Adjustable Radius

• Fling Up, Forward, Down, or Into the Void

• Spin Fling and Slam

• Fling Barrage

• Ragdoll and Launch Everyone

• Bring Selected Player or Everyone

🎯 TARGETING

• Silent Aim

• Adjustable Silent Aim Radius

• Visible Targets Only

• Further Grab Reach

• Smart Target Approach

• Selected Player Controls

• Teleport Behind Target

✋ GRAB TOOLS

• Forced Grab Target

• Grab Nearest or Selected Player

• Infinite Hold

• Hold All Players

• Grab Everyone

• Freeze Held Players

• Held Player Radar

• Auto Launch Escaping Players

• Yo-Yo Target

• Suction Mode

• Steal Held Player

• Beam Slam

• Maximum Grab Reach

• Spin Target Around You

🔥 OBJECT CHAOS

• Poison Rain and Poison Storm

• Fling All Map Objects

• Fling Looked-At Object

• Fling Everything Nearby

• Object Rain on Target

• Object Swarm on Target

• Total Chaos Combo

• Launch All Animals

🛡️ PROTECTION

• Anti Grab

• Automatic Self Defense

• Anti Kick-Grab Recovery

• Anti Explosive

• Fling Blocker

• Revenge Ragdoll

• Instant Get Up

• Void Rescue

• Automatic Ground Return

• Emergency Self Reset

👻 TROLL FEATURES

• Drag Target Around

• Pin Target in the Sky

• Spin Target

• Head Hopper

• Carpet Mode

• Fake Lag

• Teleport Slam Combo

• Random Player Fling

• Follow and Watch Target

🏃 MOVEMENT

• Fly with Adjustable Speed

• Speed Boost

• Noclip

• Infinite Jump

• Mega Jump

• Third-Person Camera

• Map and Player Teleports

👁️ VISUALS

• Player ESP with Names and Distance

• Grabbable Object ESP

• Adjustable ESP Range

• Fullbright

⚙️ EXTRA

• Desktop and Mobile Support

• Rejoin Current Server

• Server Hop

• Clean Organized Interface
